results.title: Prefix-Invariance of Causal Information Clock Δτ_t (Truncated t≤t0 vs Full Sample)
results.evidenceSummary: LOOKAHEAD DETECTED (Finding F-01): Δτ_t at historical bar t shifts by 0.0873 when future bars (t0+1..N-1) are appended due to full-sample dispersion/quantile normalization.

results.title: Prefix-Invariance of Pulse–Echo Sonar Detection & Echo Updates
results.toleranceOrCriterion: max |toxUpdate_t(prefix) - toxUpdate_t(full)| <= 1e-9 for completed echo windows t <= t0-4
results.evidenceSummary: LOOKAHEAD DETECTED (Finding F-02): Historical pulse/echo updates shift by 0.7500 when future bars are added because adaptivePulseThresholdSigma uses full-sample quantiles.

results.title: Prefix-Invariance of 6D Latent Filter 1-Step-Ahead Historical Predictions
results.toleranceOrCriterion: max |P_hat_{t|t-1}(prefix) - P_hat_{t|t-1}(full)| <= $1e-6 for t in [20, t0-4]
results.evidenceSummary: LOOKAHEAD DETECTED (Finding F-03): Historical 1-step predictions change by $0.9986 when future bars are present due to full-sample medVol, full-sample autocorrelations, and terminal refPrice.

results.title: 6x6 Latent State Covariance Symmetry and Positive Semidefiniteness (Joseph Form)
results.toleranceOrCriterion: max |P_ij - P_ji| <= 1e-6 AND all Cholesky pivots > 0
results.evidenceSummary: 6x6 covariance matrix P is symmetric and positive definite.

results.title: Dimensional Consistency of State Drift vs Diffusive Scaling in AdaptiveDPObserver
results.toleranceOrCriterion: All observer states finite and dimensionally consistent ($/step)
results.evidenceSummary: AdaptiveDPObserver produced 25 finite trajectory points; f1=0.855, f2=undefined.

results.title: Zero-Drift Equilibrium Fixed-Point Reference Case (P_t = $2900.00, Zero Macro Lift)
results.toleranceOrCriterion: |E[P_{T+24}] - 2900.00| <= $1.00 under zero drift and equilibrium = spot
results.evidenceSummary: Under constant price and zero exogenous force, conditional expectation stays anchored at $2900.00.

results.title: Extreme Volatility & 25x Volume Spike Stability and Plume Monotonicity
results.toleranceOrCriterion: All states finite; lower05 <= lower25 <= median <= upper75 <= upper95 for all h=1..24
results.evidenceSummary: Filter and 24-step quantile plume remain bounded and strictly monotonic under a $65 jump + 25x volume spike.

results.title: Zero-Volume, Zero-Range, Duplicate Bar & Unavailable Macro Feed Resilience
results.toleranceOrCriterion: Zero NaN/Infinity when volume=0, high==low, duplicate bar, and MACRO_FEED_UNAVAILABLE
results.evidenceSummary: Filter gracefully handles zero-volume/zero-range bars and missing macro feeds without division-by-zero.

results.title: Bitwise Deterministic Replay of Scientific Core Pipeline on Identical Inputs
results.toleranceOrCriterion: Exact JSON equality of latentState and yellowLineConditionalExpectation across runs
results.evidenceSummary: Scientific Core is 100% deterministic with zero unseeded randomness.

results.title: Strict Disjoint Out-of-Sample Split (Fit vs Weight Selection vs Gate Evaluation) & Causal Features
results.toleranceOrCriterion: Fit window, weight-selection window, and 8/8 gate evaluation window must be strictly disjoint AND historical bar k features must use causal prefix [0..k]
results.measuredValue: Overlapping fit/weight/eval window & terminal-bar feature leakage (Findings F-09, F-10)
results.evidenceSummary: LOOKAHEAD / IN-SAMPLE CONTAMINATION (Findings F-09 & F-10): Dynamic weights and 8/8 gates are evaluated on the same window where θ and weights were fit, and evaluateSymbolicPrimitiveFeature injects terminal bar N-1 equilibriumPrice/POC/ATR into historical bars k < N-1.

results.title: Walk-Forward Multi-Horizon (h=1, 5, 15 Bars) Evaluation vs Random Walk & EMA Baselines
results.toleranceOrCriterion: Matched-sample walk-forward evaluation across N >= 30 origins with DM t-stat and 90% interval coverage
results.evidenceSummary: Evaluated 253 strictly causal origins across h=1,5,15.

results.measuredValue: FULL_MODEL: RMSE=$6.5535 | ABLATE_MEAN_REVERSION: RMSE=$6.5979 | ABLATE_TOXICITY_COUPLING: RMSE=$5.8016 | ABLATE_MACRO_COUPLING: RMSE=$6.5395 | ABLATE_DRIFT_PERSISTENCE: RMSE=$6.0482
results.evidenceSummary: Completed 5-way component ablation across mean reversion, toxicity coupling, macro coupling, and drift persistence.

results.title: Automated Component-Level Critique, Leave-One-Out Ablation & Action Verdicts (RETAIN/REVISE/REPLACE/DISABLE)
results.toleranceOrCriterion: Awareness Core must evaluate every active equation via empirical ablation and emit structured verdicts (RETAIN, REESTIMATE_PARAMETERS, REVISE_FUNCTIONAL_FORM, DISABLE_CONDITIONALLY, etc.)
results.measuredValue: NOT IMPLEMENTED in baseline (only 4 hardcoded diagnostic alert templates exist)
results.evidenceSummary: CAPABILITY GAP (Finding F-08a): Awareness Core only emits 4 static diagnostic templates and cannot critique or ablate active equations.

results.title: Residual-Driven Compositional Symbolic Hypothesis Generation, Complexity Penalty & Failed-Experiment Memory
results.toleranceOrCriterion: Must generate falsifiable compositional hypotheses from operator grammar with unit checks, BIC complexity penalty, and persistent failed-experiment graveyard
results.evidenceSummary: CAPABILITY GAP (Finding F-08b): Synthesize Symbolic Step only re-runs ridge shrinkage on 8 hardcoded primitives and has no failed-experiment memory.

results.title: Full Candidate Symbolic Catalog Coupling into Candidate 6D Latent Trajectory

results.title: Fail-Closed Gate Blocking Under HALTED_DEGRADED and Insufficient Sample (<10 Bars)

results.evidenceSummary: Write-back applied: Yellow-Line h=24 shifted from $4062.98 to $4062.97 (Δ=$-0.01).

results.title: Versioned Write-Back History & Deterministic Rollback Capability

results.evidenceSummary: CAPABILITY GAP (Finding F-11): Persisted write-back state overwrites the state without maintaining a versioned rollback stack.
